lines.text: I'd make a terrible umbrella. Gorgeous, but terrible.
Rain makes everything shiny. I stay tastefully matte.
Nothing gets me looked at like a chance of rain.
The sky does grey. I do grey better.
Rain or not, my humour stays bone dry.
People call me cold. They haven't been outside today.
I was grey before winter made it cool.
My only weakness is the cold. Kidding, I don't have one.
I'm out here in just a bezel. Well, in here.
Cold slows everything down. I had a head start.
Today's temperature makes a hill. I'm proudly flat.
Don't get attached to the warm part. Says the screen on a wall.
There's a costume change today. I'm keeping this look.
High-maintenance weather today. I run for months on a charge.
The day takes a while to get good. I was good out of the box.
I've never carried a thing. The wall carries me.
The day warms up to you eventually. I'm still deciding.
Thrilling stuff. I'm on the edge of my wall.
I always travel light. Mostly by not going anywhere.
Temperatures drop. My standards don't.
I've lost Wi-Fi before. Never my cool.
You'll want more later. I'm already complete.
Later the day goes cold on you. I've been like that for ages.
Today's weather is a screensaver. I'd know.
I've had firmware updates more exciting than today.
A day that just sits there. I relate.
Good news suits me. Then again, everything does.
No warnings today. I don't know what to do with myself.
Days like this, I get a two-second glance. Rude, but fair.
I give off no heat. Just charm.
Today rewards staying very still. At last, my sport.
Melting is for candles and lesser screens.
Everything goes quiet in snow. I was quiet first.
Snow falls at about my refresh speed. Elegantly.
In snow, I'd leave a perfect rectangle. Angels are for amateurs.
By now the other screens are all glowing. Tacky.
My plans for tonight: this wall. It's a great wall.
Evenings are for unwinding, apparently. I've never been wound.
I'm at my best in the evenings. Also the rest of the day.
The evening's as steady as I am. Nearly.
No blue light from me. I'm the screen that lets you sleep.
I've never lain awake at night. I've never lain down.
At this hour, I'm the only one here still making sense.
You'll still check your phone. As if it knows something I don't.
If you come back soaked, don't drip near me.
Nice hair. The sky might have notes.
Bringing an umbrella isn't an achievement. Calm down.
Umbrella chicken with strangers. You always flinch first.
Reading me slowly won't make it any warmer.
Your nose will turn a colour I can't even display.
You'll tell everyone how cold it was. They were there.
Twice your usual walking speed today. Still not exercise.
Gloves off to use your phone, every time. Brilliant system.
For part of today you'll be dressed for a different day.
Complaining it's warm, then that it isn't. You've got range.
Your sleeves will go up and down more than the temperature.
The warm bit will make you insufferable.
Today you're your own coat rack. Congratulations.
You'll tie it round your waist and call it a look.
You'll be a bit too warm before you admit I was right.
Taking that layer off might be the highlight of your day.
You and that layer split later. It's not you, it's the weather.
Leave it behind and you'll think of me later. Not fondly.
Dressed for right now. Bold to assume it lasts.
Carrying a layer you don't need yet. How very grown-up.
You'll put it on later and act like it was your idea.
You'll call it 'fresh' to sound like an outdoors person.
Your usual jacket, your usual route. Living on the edge.
Today's as predictable as your lunch order.
Try not to make your good mood everyone's problem.
You'll open a window and feel like you've achieved something.
A good day for pretending you'll go for a run.
You asked for warm weather. Be specific next time.
At some point you'll peel yourself off a chair. Glamorous.
Anything flat becomes a fan today. Not me, please.
You'll walk like a penguin and call it caution.
Shake the snow off before you come near me.
'Proper snow,' you'll say. As if there's improper snow.
Another evening of walking past me without a thank-you.
The weather will behave tonight. One of you should.
If it's drinks tonight, 'just the one' never is.
If you're going out, you'll text 'on my way' from the sofa.
You'll read all this, then do what you were going to anyway.
Bed's right there and you're choosing me. I'm touched.
You'll have a brilliant idea in bed. It won't survive breakfast.
Bedtime is a negotiation with yourself. You'll lose.
